title: Replicating the Non-Monotonic Safety Curve on a Second Model Family

original_idea.body: Self-jailbreaking audit (extends arXiv:2510.20956): run StrongReject prompts on 2-3 open reasoning models, label whether CoT verbalizes a self-granted justification vs silent compliance; report verbalization rate for CoT-monitoring.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying unverbalized self-jailbreaks directly informs CoT-monitoring viability, a recognized oversight pathway.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: 2-3 reasoning models + CoT capture + hand-labeling 150 traces; accessible but labeling is labor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused verbalization-rate deliverable; manual labeling adds a workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model-organism CoT-blindness study, open models, neglected, benefits from external scrutiny.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only on small open reasoning models.

novelty.reasoning: Self-jailbreaking documented but verbalization-rate quantification likely novel.
